name: mobile-admin-ui-auto-loop
objective: Automatically scan, test, and guide premium StrideX Mobile Admin UI improvements without changing backend/API/business logic.

loop.expected: All Admin screens are mapped to backend-supported modules.
Only mechanical UI fixes are applied: bottom padding, obvious route correction, safe tooltips/spacing if implemented.
Screens with low luxury score are prioritized for manual UI polish.

loop.command: cd mobile; dart format lib test; powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\init.ps1 -Analyze; powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\init.ps1 -Test

loop.expected: Open Admin routes in Chrome/mobile viewport and verify no clipped chips, bottom-nav overlap, empty-state overlap, or mojibake.

allowed: Add safe bottom padding for fixed bottom navigation.
Correct Settings routes to backend-supported standalone modules.
Add missing tooltip to icon-only buttons.
Improve spacing, card radius, shadows, and empty-state presentation without changing callbacks.
